question: Taking South Australia's 7:30-8:00 am half-hour (Adelaide time, ACST) on 20 August 2026: what POE10, POE50 and POE90 operational demand values were in the final forecast run issued ahead of it, and what operational demand was actually measured?

shown_answer.headline: For 2026-08-20 08:00 ACST the forecast run PUBLIC_FORECAST_OPERATIONAL_DEMAND_HH_202608200830_20260820080131 gave POE50 = 1594.0 MW, POE10 = 1663.0 MW, POE90 = 1525.0 MW; actual operational demand was 1567.0 MW.
summary: Run PUBLIC_FORECAST_OPERATIONAL_DEMAND_HH_202608200830_20260820080131 (issued 2026-08-19T21:57:01Z) for target end (local time) 2026-08-20 08:00 ACST (UTC+0930) reported POE50 = 1594.0 MW, POE10 = 1663.0 MW and POE90 = 1525.0 MW.
The measured operational demand for that half-hour (target end (local time) 2026-08-20 08:00 ACST) was 1567.0 MW; the forecast error (POE50 − actual) is 27.0 MW (1.72%).
The forecast MAE over the paired half-hours in the compared window is 149.81 MW.

possible_explanations.statement: The 27.0 MW forecast error might reflect short-term demand variability between the forecast issue and the half-hour ending 2026-08-20 08:00 ACST.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare higher-frequency demand or dispatch traces and forecasts issued immediately before 2026-08-20 08:00 ACST (2026-08-19T22:30:00Z) to see if variability at that time explains the 27.0 MW error.

possible_explanations.statement: Network events such as the Tailem Bend to South East No.2 line short-notice outage reported in the market notice [c1] could be related to differences between forecast and actual.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Check constraint and dispatch flow changes and operational records at 2026-08-20T04:15:00Z (2026-08-20 13:45 ACST) from AEMO/Network systems and compare with demand/forecast pairs around 2026-08-20 08:00 ACST.

published_findings.statement: An AEMO market notice for SA1 [c1] says: “At 1415 hrs 20/08/2026 there was a short notice outage of Tailem Bend to South East No.2 275 kV Line.” (NEM market time, UTC+10: 2026-08-20T04:15:00Z = 2026-08-20 13:45 ACST.)

numeric_claims.text: Mean absolute error (MAE) over the paired half-hours in the compared window
